queries.body_or_sql:
GET https://explorer.near-intents.org/api/v0/transactions?numberOfTransactions=1000&direction=next&statuses=FAILED,PROCESSING,REFUNDED,SUCCESS&startTimestampUnix=<UTC day start - 1>&endTimestampUnix=<UTC day start + 86400>
Authorization: Bearer <redacted partner token>
(one UTC day per walk, cursor lastDepositAddress/lastDepositMemo, >= 5.2 s between requests; only per-day aggregates are kept)
